description: This file defines the du_processor_repository class, which manages DU processor objects, including adding, removing, and querying DUs, as well as handling DU metrics reports within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: du_repository_config
classes.description: Configuration structure holding references to various handlers and managers required by du_processor_repository.

classes.name: du_processor_repository
classes.description: Class managing DU processor objects, providing methods for adding, removing, and querying DUs, and handling metrics reports.

classes.name: du_context
classes.description: Internal structure holding context information for each DU, including notifier, processor, and notifier for F1AP messages.

methods.name: du_processor_repository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repository with provided configuration.

methods.name: find_du
methods.description: Finds the DU index serving a cell with a specific PCI.

methods.name: find_du
methods.description: Finds the DU index serving a cell with a specific CGI.

methods.name: find_du_processor
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the DU processor object for a given DU index.

methods.name: get_du_processor
methods.description: Returns a reference to the DU processor object for a given DU index.

methods.name: get_du_processor_indexes
methods.description: Returns a list of all DU indexes managed by the repository.

methods.name: handle_du_metrics_report_request
methods.description: Handles and returns DU metrics report data.

methods.name: get_nof_f1ap_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of F1AP UEs.

methods.name: get_nof_rrc_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of RRC UEs.

methods.name: add_du
methods.description: Adds a new DU processor object and returns its index.

methods.name: remove_du
methods.description: Removes a DU processor object asynchronously.

methods.name: get_nof_dus
methods.description: Returns the total number of DUs managed.

methods.name: get_next_du_index
methods.description: Generates and returns the next available DU index.
